{{Top|leg}}
The rank of '''Colonel-Supervisor''' was a rank superior to that of [[Captain-Supervisor]]. Captain-Supervisor [[Grammel]], an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] officer in command of the garrison and mining operation on the planet [[Mimban/Legends|Circarpous V]], was promised the rank of Colonel-Supervisor by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bin Essada/Legends|Bin Essada]] of [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] once [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] were delivered to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Grammel failed at this task, and was killed by Darth Vader for his failure, still a lowly Captain-Supervisor.<ref name="SotME">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>
